Title: Zip Gun damage if combat ends?

Messages.Author: Ashur
Messages.Body:
a) Do a vampire using a Zip Gun take damage from the Zip Gun if the opposing minion play a Strike: Combat Ends-strike?
b) Where do I find the answer to this question in the rulebook?

Zip Gun
Combat
Before range is determined, put this card on this minion. This card represents an equipment card and doesn't count as a combat card while in play. This equipment is a weapon, gun. Ammo cards cannot be used with this gun. It does 1R damage each strike, with an optional maneuver each combat. Bearer takes 1 damage during strike resolution when striking with this gun, but only once each combat. This card is kept as normal equipment and is not discarded after combat.

"My strategy? Luck is my strategy, of course."

Messages.Author: Ohlmann
Messages.Body:
a) Zip gun strike is not resolved, so you don't take damage.
b)
>
> Combat Ends. This effect ends combat immediately. This type of strike is always the first to resolve, even before a strike done with first strike, and it ends combat before other strikes or other strike resolution effects are resolved.
>
So, since the combat end before the resolution of other strike, they are not resolved.

Messages.Author: jamesatzephyr
Messages.Body:
> ReverendRevolver wrote:
> Also, i still dont understand why zip gun doesnt trigger flesh of marble.
>
In what way do you think it doesn't interact with Flesh of Marble? It's just damage.

The usual bit that used to catch people out was that the side-effect damage to yourself is not considered to be "damage from a strike". Ditto, self-inflicted damage from Burst of Sunlight and similar cards. Important for, say, Leather Jacket. But I can't remember that coming up as a question in years.
